notes: Beth-haccherem is one MACULA lemma segmented as two Np tokens and the ASV writes a word for each, so it is aligned token to token rather than as one noncompositional unit.
מִצָּפוֹן carries no segmented article, so the 'the' of 'the north' is supplied to the noun under rule 15; the same holds for 'the trumpet' and 'the midst'.
